newsitem.title: USA: Voice Control files registration statement.
newsitem.headline: Voice Control files registration statement.

text.p: Voice Control Systems Inc said Friday that it has filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission pursuant to the terms of its merger with privately-held Voice Processing Corp.

The registration statement covers 709,716 shares which are reserved for issuance to holders of options and warrants and 1,855,302 shares, of which 1,723,953 have been previously eligible for resale pursuant to Rule 144.
The company said it will not receive any proceeds from the sale of these shares, but will get about $2,055,000 if all the options and warrants being registered are exercised.
Voice Control Systems is a global supplier of speech recognition and speaker verification technology.
